title: Voice: each voice session gets its own mastermind, logged

chat.text: Each voice session now gets its own Opus mastermind (voice-mastermind skill), spawned on its first question and reused for later ones; the gateway tracks sessions and keeps the map across restarts, and logs every question and answer. Needs a Servex restart to go live. Docs: /framework/ux/Dictate/doc/voice-bridge.md
